sections.title: Above the fold
sections.guide: One headline: the service and the city, exactly as the ads say it. Under it, same-day service or a free estimate in one line, and the phone as a tap-to-call button. Say 'licensed' only when the licence number appears on the page; name the coverage whenever the page mentions insurance ('general liability insured'), and never say 'bonded': California disciplines an insurance mention that names no coverage, and 'bonded', on a website too.
sections.example: HVAC Repair in Austin — same-day service. Call (512) 555-0100.

sections.title: Why this business
sections.guide: Three short reasons taken from the business's own facts: the licence number, years in business, the insurance coverage named ('general liability insured'), photos of work already done. Real reviews with the reviewer's first name and the source; never a review the business did not receive.
sections.example: Licensed · general liability insured · 12 years in Austin · 4.8★ (86 reviews)

sections.title: What happens when you call
sections.guide: Three or four plain sentences: the arrival window, the price or that the estimate is free, and what is included. No promises about results.
sections.example: Call before noon and we're there the same day. Estimates are free and the price is confirmed before any work starts.

sections.title: Request a quote
sections.guide: Name, phone, the service, the ZIP code, and when the work is needed. One line under the button saying when the business calls back.
sections.example: We call back within one business day.

sections.title: Questions people ask
sections.guide: Four to six questions with one-paragraph answers: the price or the estimate, how soon someone can arrive, whether there is emergency service, what the warranty covers, which areas are served.
sections.example: Do you offer emergency service? Yes, evenings and weekends at no extra call-out fee.

sections.title: Hours and where
sections.guide: Opening hours, the service area with a map link, the phone again.

sections.title: Footer
sections.guide: The business's name, a Terms link, the Privacy notice link (required when the page has a form), the business's phone or e-mail, and the licence number — required on every page and ad in California, Florida, Texas (HVAC) and Washington.
sections.example: Cool Air HVAC · License #TACLA00000C · Terms · Privacy · (512) 555-0100

form_rules: Ask for the ZIP code so the assistant can confirm the service area.
Ask when the work is needed: today, this week, or flexible.
Say when the business calls back.

required_lines.when: California, Florida, Texas (HVAC), Washington: the contractor licence number on every page and ad

faq: How soon can you get here?
